winner_analysis.why_it_won: It works with the sound off: the first second shows a recognizable drawer chaos, and the slow-motion magnetic click is satisfying like ASMR.
winner_analysis.keep_unchanged: Everything after second 3: mismatched socks in hand, the slow-motion click, the washer timelapse, the neat drawer and the end card with the offer. The ad has no voiceover, so first_line here is the first-frame text.

variants.hook_visual: The same drawer in POV: a hand digs through the socks, a pair counter in the corner stays at zero.
variants.why: The counter amplifies the pain without words and works with the sound off.

variants.hook_visual: The drawer opens and endless mismatched socks spring out like a clown car (simple motion loop).
variants.why: The “X like:” meme format is instantly recognizable, and the exaggeration makes the pain funny.

variants.hook_visual: Black screen, only the magnetic click sound and text. Then a light turns on over a chaotic drawer.
variants.first_line: This one sound fixed my sock drawer.
variants.why: Intrigue through sound makes people turn it on and wait for the explanation.

variants.hook_visual: A perfectly organized drawer with dividers (stock), a red line strikes the text through, cut to a real chaotic drawer.
variants.first_line: Drawer organizers won't save your socks.
variants.why: It rejects popular advice and leads to the real cause: pairs come apart in the wash.

variants.hook_visual: Macro: two SockLock socks lie next to each other in the drawer and click together (simple motion over a product shot).
variants.first_line: Socks that find their own pair.
variants.why: Product magic in one second: a visual “wow” without explanation.

variants.hook_visual: Phone footage: a kid holds two different socks up to the camera.
variants.why: A familiar family moment adds emotion: parents recognize their own mornings.

variants.hook_visual: Quick cuts of three 0.5 s shots: a sock under the couch, behind the washer, in the toy bin.
variants.first_line: Under the couch. Behind the washer. In the toy bin.
variants.why: The “searching the whole house” montage shows the scale of the pain and sets the rhythm.

variants.hook_visual: A “Lost & Found” sign on the drawer, the camera slowly pushes in, the drawer opens.
variants.first_line: Our sock drawer is basically a lost and found.
variants.why: A simple household metaphor, clear in one second and without sound.

warnings: The original has no voiceover: first_line in these variants is the first-frame text. If you add a voiceover, it shouldn't repeat on_screen_text.
H05 “Socks that find their own pair” is an artistic exaggeration. The magnet only works up close, so don't show socks pulling together across the whole drawer.
H03 asks viewers to turn the sound on: it makes sense for Reels and Stories, other variants are better for the feed.
